```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("clin_effect_table_s2")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  funs = c("dag_helpers", "assoc_tests", "tlr_landmark", "dag_association_tests"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "dagitty", "survival",
               "coxphf", "logistf", "coin"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)

# Edge and conditional-independence lists are derived from the canonical `dag`
# object (dag_helpers.R) by dag_association_tests.R, so this table always tests
# the graph shown in Figure S1 (issue #155). The week-9 landmark PFS cohort is
# used for TLR -> PFS and a time-dependent progression indicator for PFS -> OS.
dd <- prepare_dag_data(data, landmark = "week9")
lm_label <- tolower(dd$landmark$spec$short_label)
```

```{r run-tests, include=FALSE}
edge_results <- run_dag_edge_tests(dag, dd)
ci_results <- run_dag_ci_tests(dag, dd, seed = analysis_seed)

consolidated_summary_table <- bind_rows(
  edge_results |>
    transmute(Domain = "Direct edge", Item, Test, Effect,
              `p-value` = fmt_p(p_value), Conclusion),
  ci_results |>
    transmute(Domain = "Conditional independence", Item, Test, Effect,
              `p-value` = fmt_p(p_value), Conclusion)
)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(consolidated_summary_table,
      caption = "Consolidated summary of direct edge and conditional-independence tests",
      format = "html") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  pack_rows("Direct edges", 1, nrow(edge_results)) |>
  pack_rows("Conditional independence", nrow(edge_results) + 1, nrow(consolidated_summary_table)) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Data from METIMMOX trial (NCT03388190). Scripts 02 and 03 sourced.",
      "CRP = C-reactive protein; TLR = target lesion reduction; TMB = tumor mutational burden; TxTMB = T x TMB/BRAF; TxCRP = T x CRP.",
      "Edge and conditional-independence lists are derived from the canonical DAG (dag_helpers.R). Edges from the latent node U and into the interaction nodes are not tested; two statements relating TxCRP and TxTMB given T hold by construction.",
      "Firth-corrected Cox and logistic regression used throughout. Fisher's exact for 2x2 tables.",
      sprintf("PFS -> OS: Firth Cox for death with a time-dependent progression indicator (counting-process time), not PFS time as a baseline covariate. TLR -> PFS: Firth Cox on the %s landmark PFS cohort (n = %d, progression-free after the landmark, time from the landmark), the cohort used in Figure 1.", lm_label, nrow(dd$data_lm_pfs)),
      "Arm balance checks: Age||T, CRP||T, Sex||T, T||TMB_BRAF. CRP is the week-4 value (before the first nivolumab dose), so CRP||T tests arm balance at the immunotherapy decision point, not randomization balance. No multiplicity correction applied."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-csv, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("outputs", "tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write_artifact_csv(consolidated_summary_table, file = here("outputs", "tables", "clin_effect_table_s2.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved to:", here("outputs", "tables", "clin_effect_table_s2.csv"), "\n")
```

Table saved to `outputs/tables/clin_effect_table_s2.csv`.

```{r artifact-manifest, include=FALSE}
finish_artifact_render()
```
